channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, LatAm, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
3 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 27 Jul 2026 (27 Jul to 02 Aug 2026).

  • ProAC / Fomento CultSP: Edital 05/2026, Electronic Games Development and Publishing
    Secretaria da Cultura, Economia e Industria Criativas do Estado de Sao Paulo (ProAC) · deadline Closed 27 Jul 2026 · BRL 300,000 (around USD 55,000 / EUR 50,000) per selected project, 20 projects total across two modules, from a BRL 6,000,000 pool. Registration is free.
  • Red Quincho: Beca Constelaciones 2026 (4th Edition)
    Red Quincho · deadline Closed 09 Aug 2026 · ARS 1,000,000 (around USD 690) per grant toward mobility, living costs and production, plus one month of lodging. 15 grants available. No application fee.
